weights.label: Price
weights.description: Current local-currency price in the market (lower is better). No currency conversion.

weights.label: Electric range
weights.description: Electric range on the same test cycle for every car (higher is better). Never converted between cycles.

weights.label: DC fast charging
weights.description: Peak DC fast-charging power (higher is better). A recorded absence of a DC inlet counts as 0 because it is known.

weights.label: AC charging
weights.description: Maximum AC charging power (higher is better).

weights.label: Energy efficiency
weights.description: Electricity consumption on the same cycle and mode (lower is better).

weights.label: Trunk space
weights.description: Trunk volume in litres (higher is better).

weightNotes: Range and DC charging weigh more because you make two or more long trips a month.
Efficiency weighs more because you drive 60 km or more a day.
AC charging weighs more because you can charge at home.

decision.message: No decisive recommendation: the matching cars lack needed data or their data is not comparable. See the missing data, or set the weight of a missing factor to 0.

notRanked.explanation: Not ranked because its current local price is not available, so the budget cannot be checked.
